lines: d11: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jason Wilson is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d11: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d11: 🕯️ Jason Wilson is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d11: What Jason kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d11: "Jason's gone." Maya looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jason." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d11: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Carmen blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d11: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d11: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jason Wilson, 11 days. The mantle passes to Carmen Dai.
d11: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Carmen Dai, 64 — an HVAC tech. Their hands know different work now: The Touch.
d11: The village's quarrel was with Jason — and Jason is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d11: At the grave, Gina, Maya, Somchai speak for Carmen — "Jason trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d11: The fire knew Carmen before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
d52: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Carmen Dai is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d52: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d52: 🕯️ Carmen is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d52: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d52: 🕯️ Carmen's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
